book.name: LOS HECHOS
book.title: LOS HECHOS Jesús buerã cʉ̃ja ca tiirique

content: Malta yucʉ poogapʉ Pablo cʉ̃ ca biirique
Mee, niipetirãpʉra tii yucʉ poogare pãa earã, “Malta ca wãme cʉtiri yucʉ pooga niijapa,” jãa ĩi majiwʉ.
Bojoca too ca nii jʉo dooricarã pea, jãa niipetirãpʉrena añuro jãare tiiwa. Oco rʉmʉri niima ĩiro, bʉaro ca yʉjʉaro macã too macãrã pea, pairi pecame dio yapano, “Jumarã dooya,” jãare ĩiwa.
Pablo cãa peca ca boporijere ca jeericʉ niiri, teere jee tĩagʉ tii niiwi. To cʉ̃ ca tiiro, aña ca ajirijere duti witi waagʉra, Pablo amopʉ bacacã ñaañumu waawi.

Cʉ̃re cʉ̃ ca baca ñaañumu waaro ĩarã, too macãrã pea o biro ameri ĩiwa:Pablore aña bacawi. Hch 28.3-5 —Ania ca bojoca jĩagʉ niibumi. Dia pairi yaapʉ cãare cʉ̃ ca ametʉacã pacaro, ñañaro cʉ̃ ca tiirique wapa pea cʉ̃ ca catiro cʉ̃re booti —ĩiwa.
Pablo pea pecamepʉ añare wẽe yaye cõa joecã cojowi. Cʉ̃ peera bojoricaro biirucu, biitiwʉ.

Bojoca pea, cʉ̃re mipi, ñucã ca niiro tʉjarora dia ñaacoa, cʉ̃ ca biiro ĩarʉgarã yuemiwa. Yoaro yuerucuñami, bojoricaro biirucu cʉ̃ ca biitiro ĩari, tʉgoeña wajoari, “Biiti, jʉ̃guẽ niibumi ania,” ameri ĩiwa.
Tii tabe pʉtore niiwʉ jĩcʉ̃, tii yucʉ pooga macʉ̃ ca nii majuropeegʉ, Publio ca wãme cʉtigʉ yaa yepa. Cʉ̃ pea añuro jãare boca, cʉ̃ yaa wiipʉ itia rʉmʉ peti jãare cʉo niiwi.

To biro jãa ca biiri tabere, Publio pacʉ pea wiorique, díi yoopote mena diagʉ tiiupi. To biro ca bii yojagʉre Pablo pea cʉ̃re ĩagʉ waari, juu bue yapano, cʉ̃ amori mena cʉ̃re ñia peo, cʉ̃re tii catiocãwi.
To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ ca tii catiorije jʉori, aperã tii yucʉ pooga macãrã ca diarique cʉtirã cãa, cʉ̃ pʉto doori, cʉ̃ja ca diarique cʉtirijere ametʉene ecowa.
Paʉ apeye jãare tiicojo, waa nʉnʉa waarã jãa ca cʉope niipetiro jãare tiicojo, tiiwa.
Romapʉ Pablo cʉ̃ ca earique

Tii yucʉ poogapʉre itiarã muipũa niiri jiro, pue bʉcʉ ca niiro tii yucʉ poogara ca tua nʉcãricagara ea jãa, jãa waacoawʉ. Tii cũmua pea, Alejandría macãga, cʉ̃ja jʉ̃guẽa Cástor, Pólux're ĩa cõori cʉ̃ja ca owa tuuricarã ca tujarica niiwʉ.
Too ca waaricarãra Siracusa macãre ea, itia rʉmʉ peti jãa niiwʉ.
Too ca niiricarã, tii tabere weja jañuroacã waa nʉnʉa waa, Regio macãpʉ jãa eawʉ. Ape rʉmʉ peera, jãa jiro pee wino ca paa puu doorije ca earo, ape rʉmʉra Puteoli macãpʉ jãa eacoawʉ.
Tii macãre jĩcãrã Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerãre jãa bʉa eawʉ. Cʉ̃ja pea, “Jãa mena jĩcã semana tuaya,” jãare ĩiwa. Too bii nʉnʉa waarãpʉ, jãa ea waawʉ Romare.

Roma macãrã Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã pea to biro jãa ca bii nʉnʉa waarijere queti tʉori, Foro de Apio, ñucã Tres Tabernas ca wãme cʉtiri tabepʉ jãare bocarã dooupa. Pablo pea cʉ̃jare ĩari, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre, “Añu majuropeecã” ĩi, tʉgoeña bayi, biiwi ñucã.
Romapʉ jãa ca earo, Pablo peera bojoricaropʉ cʉ̃re cũuri, uwamʉ jĩcʉ̃rena cʉ̃re cote dotiwa.
Romapʉ añurije quetire Pablo cʉ̃ ca wederique

Itia rʉmʉ jiro Pablo pea, judíos're ca jʉo niirãre jʉo neowi. Cʉ̃ja ca nea petiro ĩa, o biro cʉ̃jare ĩiwi: —Yʉ yaarã, yʉa, mani yaa pooga macãrã menare ñañaro tiiti, ñucã mani ñicʉ̃ jʉ̃mʉa cʉ̃ja ca tii jʉo doorique mena cãare ñañarije ĩiti, yʉ ca bii pacaro Jerusalén'pʉ yʉre ñeeri, romanos'pʉre yʉre tiicojowa.
Cʉ̃ja pea yʉre jãiñari jiro, ca jĩa ecopepʉ ñañarije yʉ ca tii bui cʉtitiriquere ĩa majiri, yʉre wienecãrʉgamiwa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca tiirʉga pacaro, judíos pee cʉ̃ja ca bootiro macã, yʉ majuropeera, “Ʉpʉ Roma macʉ̃ majuropeera yʉre cʉ̃ jãiña bejejato,” yʉ ĩiwʉ. Biigʉpʉa, yʉ yaa pooga macãrãre wedejãarʉgʉ méé to biro yʉ ĩiwʉ.
Atere ĩima ĩigʉ, mʉjare ĩa, mʉja mena wede peni, tiirʉgʉ mʉjare yʉ jʉo cojojãwʉ. Mani israelitas bojoca mani ca yue niirije jʉorira, anopʉre come daari mena jiacãricʉ yʉ nii —ĩiwi Pablo.

To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, cʉ̃ja pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩiwa: —Jãa jĩcãti ʉno peera mʉ yee maquẽ quetire Judea macãrã jãare cʉ̃ja ca owa cojorijere ñeerucu, jãa tiiti. Ñucã mani yaarã judíos, Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã toopʉ macãrã ca earã cãa, jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera mʉ yee maquẽ ñañarije queti cʉti, ñañaro mʉre wede ama, tiitiwa.
To biri mʉ ca tʉgoeñari wãmere jãa tʉorʉga. Ate wãma wãme ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉoriquere niipetiri taberi macãrãpʉra ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca wede pairije wadore jãa maji —ĩiwa Pablore.

To biri Pablo mena nearʉgarã, “Tii rʉmʉ ca niiro mani neajaco” ĩi, tii rʉmʉ ca earo, cʉ̃ ca niiri wiipʉre paʉ bojoca nea poowa. Pablo pea boeri tabe ména Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca doti niiri tabe maquẽ quetire ca wede jʉoricʉ, tii rʉmʉ ca naiori tabepʉ cʉ̃jare wede yerijãawi. Moisés cʉ̃ ca doti cũurique, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yee quetire wede jʉgueri maja cʉ̃ja ca owarique mena ĩiri, Jesucristore cʉ̃ja ca tʉo nʉnʉjeero tiirʉgʉ, cʉ̃jare wedemiwi.
Pablo cʉ̃ ca ĩirijere, jĩcãrã tʉo nʉnʉjee, aperã tʉo nʉnʉjeerʉgati, biicãwa.

Cʉ̃ja majuropeera jĩcãri cõro tʉgoeñatima ĩirã, waa batecã jʉo waawa. To biro cʉ̃ja ca biro Pablo pea o biro cʉ̃jare ĩiwi: —Díámacʉ̃ra Añuri Yeri mʉja ñicʉ̃ jãa niiquĩricarãpʉre Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yee quetire wede jʉgueri majʉ Isaías menapʉ o biro ĩiquĩupi:

content.text: Ca ĩacãrã nii pacarã, ĩa jeeñotirucuma.
Ati pooga macãrã, cʉ̃ja yeripʉra ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerʉgatirã jeeñacã yai waama.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca biitijata, cʉ̃ja cape mena ĩa,
cʉ̃ja yeri menapʉ tʉo puo, tʉgoeña yeri wajoa, biibocuma.

content: ”To biri atere mʉja ca majiro yʉ boo: Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca ametʉenerije judíos ca niitirã peere wederique nii, cʉ̃ja pea teere añuro tʉo nʉnʉjeerucuma —ĩiwi Pablo.
Pablo atere o biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, judíos pea, cʉ̃ja majuropeera ameri acaro bui tuti, ĩicã tua waawa.
Pʉa cʉ̃ma peti cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca wajorica wiire
niiwi Pablo. Niipetirã cʉ̃re ca ĩarã earucurãre, ʉjea niirique mena cʉ̃jare jãi bocarucuwi.
Uwi tʉgoeñaricaro maniro, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca dotiri tabe maquẽ quetire wede, ñucã Wiogʉ Jesucristo yee maquẽre jĩcãrã peerena ĩi camota ecoricaro maniro bue, tiicõa niirucuwi.
To biro to biijato. Lucas

footnotes.text: 28.30-31Ati pũurore ca owaricʉa, cʉ̃ ca owa cojogʉre, ate jiro Pablo cʉ̃ ca bii nʉnʉa waariquepʉra wede nʉnʉa waatiupi. Añuro petira Jesucristo yee añurije queti Jerusalén mena ca bii jʉoriquera jeja nʉcã nʉnʉa waaro romanos yaa yepapʉ cãare ca eacoariquere wedegʉ cʉ̃ ca ĩirique niiupa.
